messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: sustained increase in 429/503 from inference-prod (svc=redwood-api). 5xx rate ~4x baseline across us-west; triggering oncall. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/traffic-spike

alex: I'm on it — pulling dashboards. Can folks post recent deploys?

maya: no deploys in the last 45m from infra or models. Seeing a big uptick for long-seq chat requests, embeddings slightly elevated.

len: noting a big tail in seq length distribution, KV cache miss rate up ~3x. Could be a client suddenly sending long histories.

ops-lead: impact: some tenants seeing 5xx and timeouts. Support says a handful of enterprise customers reported failures to generate. Sam, any customer comms yet?

sam: not yet, need confirmation of scope. Support, paste tenant list if you have it.

support-bot: affected-tenants.csv attached (summary): acme-corp, insight-llc, edu-data. ETA on mitigation?

alex: immediate mitigation plan: 1) apply ephemeral tenant QPS caps for noisy tenants 2) enable latency-priority routing to smaller model variant 3) temporarily disable non-critical features (chat-history prefetch) for public pool. I'll run steps 1+3 now.

maya: +1. Also suggest prefix caching for repeated prompts. Telemetry, can you surface 429 vs 503 split and per-tenant QPS?

telemetry-bot: current breakdown: 62% 429, 38% 503. Top tenants by 429: acme-corp (48%), insight-llc (17%), others spread. Dashboard: https://dashboards.redwood.internal/d/traffic/429-503-live?panel=top-tenants

alex: applying tenant caps for acme-corp and insight-llc -> 10r/s and 5r/s respectively (temp). Using redwoodctl traffic shape.

```bash
# throttle tenants
redwoodctl traffic shape --tenant=acme-corp --qps=10 --duration=30m --reason="live-mitigation-2401"
redwoodctl traffic shape --tenant=insight-llc --qps=5 --duration=30m --reason="live-mitigation-2401"
```

len: I pushed a model fallback rule to route small requests to gpt-small-quant for public pool, will prefer it for <512 tokens to reduce GPU load.

alex: disabling chat-history prefetch flag on public pool (will save KV cache churn).

```json
{"service":"flags","op":"update","flag":"chat_history_prefetch_public","value":false}
```

telemetry-bot: within 6m after the caps: overall QPS down 27%, 429 down 34% globally, 503 down 22%. Per-tenant acme-corp 429 rate dropped by 70%.

maya: good signal. Keep these caps for 30m and monitor. We should not blanket-disable embeddings — only reduce concurrency.

ops-lead: support: prepare an email template for affected customers with ETA and workaround (retry/backoff guidance). Sam to ok.

sam: draft incoming in #customer-comms, go ahead and send to affected list once we validate stability in 15m.

len: minor note — observed elevated connection queue length on inference-proxy-07, increasing timeouts. I scaled proxy replicas by +2 (k8s).

```bash
kubectl scale deploy inference-proxy -n prod --replicas=8
kubectl get pods -n prod -l app=inference-proxy -o "jsonpath='{.items[*].metadata.name}'"
```

alex: monitoring logs for 503 origin errors. Stack traces show occasional model server OOM on long sequences — probably noisy client. We'll keep quota then follow up with customer teams.

maya: create follow-up ticket to add sequence-length quotas per-tenant and a more proactive prefix-cache for common histories. Add post-incident eval to see if fallback degrades quality.

incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2401234 - "High 429/503 due to long-seq churn". Pager duty link: https://pd.redwood/inci/INC-2401234

alex: handoff: stability improved after caps and model fallback. 429 rate still slightly above baseline but trending down. I'm handing to maya for overnight watch. Notes:
- caps applied to acme-corp & insight-llc until 2401236700
- fallback rule active for <512 tokens
- chat_history_prefetch_public disabled
- proxy scaled +2 replicas

maya: taking over. I'll keep the caps in place and re-evaluate at next check-in (in 20m). If we see a regression revert fallback and increase caps carefully.

support-bot: customer-impact note: acme-corp reporting 60% failures before mitigation; now reports retries succeeding. Logged customer support tickets: #54321, #54322.

sam: thanks team. Postmortem draft assigned to alex+len+maya. Include timelined dashboard screenshots and the post-incident QA plan.

alex: quick checklist for handoff: monitor 429/503 panels, ensure incident ticket updated, keep comms to affected tenants. Maya you have PD contact?

maya: yep. ping me if anything spikes again. Good catch all. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Reminder: add severity & customer-impact to INC-2401234 within 2 hours per policy."
